job.rawJd:
Inizio Evoke is seeking a Senior Account Director. The role is listed in New York, New York and described as remote.

Execution responsibilities include serving as the daily account lead with proactive client communication; accountability for multiple large, high-value client projects; ensuring junior team members deliver quality weekly client status reports, meetings, and actionable contact reports; leading informed project kickoffs; keeping teams fluent in client Medical/Legal/Regulatory review processes and improving MLR submissions; owning the total client budget; working with project management on forecasts and financial goals; deploying resources profitably; developing and presenting scopes of work; and participating in new-business opportunities and pitches.

Client relationship responsibilities include strengthening direct and senior client relationships, finding ways to serve the client and grow both the client business and the agency business, earning client trust, receiving feedback, and handling difficult conversations with care.

Strategy responsibilities include leading brand planning with strategy and creative teams; understanding the client business, category, channels, and audiences; leading project and creative or strategic briefs; and working with strategy and analytics teams to assess performance and identify optimization opportunities.

Qualifications include 7+ years managing healthcare or pharmaceutical marketing accounts; at least 5 years on the agency and/or pharmaceutical side; multichannel marketing experience; the ability to develop and grow client relationships and identify growth opportunities; solution-oriented thinking; understanding of multidisciplinary teams and when to engage resources; attention to detail and self-accountability; organization across multiple projects and new-business work; and strong listening, speaking, and business-writing skills. The posting lists a base salary range of $140,000 to $175,000 USD.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Account Director role with Inizio Evoke. During my second and most recent stint at FCB Health, I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business. I managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch and led the broadcast workstream for three national television commercials in one year. The work covered market research, med-legal review, FDA preclearance, production, talent and location coordination, and network clearances. The spots drove a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks. Earlier at FCB Health, I supported the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, owning weekly client status and financial reporting, OPDP submissions, multichannel campaign delivery, and annual strategic recommendations.

After FCB Health, I joined Scout Marketing as an Account Supervisor / Digital Strategist and led Jazz Pharmaceuticals' XYREM consumer work. I guided unbranded campaigns across digital, print, and in-office channels, including Jazz's first unbranded social campaign and a digital program that doubled qualified traffic to the brand site. Earlier in my account career at RosettaWishbone, I was the primary client contact across brand teams, national affiliates, and vendors. I also handled briefs, scopes of work, key opinion leader communication, client status, and financial reporting for an Africa and Middle East advisory board in Dubai.

Since my last titled account role, I have stayed close to clients while adding experience in team leadership, analytics, and regulated workflow design. At Kinesso, I grew a distributed design team from 2 to 30 and led work for enterprise analytics used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands. Today, I build tools for pharmaceutical agencies that support claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, and MLR preparation. I am coming back to account leadership with a clearer view of how teams work and where delivery breaks down. I am also better at turning data into recommendations clients can use.

The role makes sense for where I am now: it brings me back to healthcare account leadership with more experience building teams and improving delivery. I would welcome the chance to discuss how that background could support Inizio Evoke's clients and teams.

resume.summary: Healthcare account leader with eight years in pharmaceutical agency account management, progressing from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor. I led Fortune 500 relationships and budgets up to $20M across multichannel programs, FDA/OPDP/med-legal review, client reporting, and strategic recommendations. Since then, I have grown a design team from 2 to 30 and built MLR and agency workflow tools, bringing deeper team leadership and product judgment back to account leadership.
